parameters.name: num_stock_width_types
parameters.description: Number of available standard stock width types

parameters.name: required_width
parameters.description: Required width of each order i

parameters.name: required_length
parameters.description: Required length of each order i

parameters.name: standard_width
parameters.description: Standard width of each stock type s

parameters.name: splicing_allowed
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether length pieces may be joined

variables.name: pattern_usage_count
variables.description: Usage count of each cutting pattern p

variables.name: stock_type_of_pattern
variables.description: Stock width type used by each pattern p

variables.name: orders_in_pattern
variables.description: Indicator of whether an order is included in a pattern p

variables.name: allocated_width
variables.description: Width allocated to each included order within a pattern p

variables.name: allocated_length
variables.description: Length allocated to each included order within a pattern p

variables.name: pattern_waste_area
variables.description: Waste area generated by each pattern p

variables.name: total_waste_area
variables.description: Total waste area across all used stock material

constraints.name: nonnegative_problem_sizes
constraints.description: Number of orders and number of stock width types must be positive integers

constraints.name: indexing_domain
constraints.description: Orders and stock width types use 0-based indexing over their respective sets

constraints.name: nonnegative_requirements
constraints.description: Required widths and required lengths must be nonnegative for all orders

constraints.name: nonnegative_stock_widths
constraints.description: Standard stock widths must be nonnegative for all stock types

constraints.name: pattern_usage_integer_nonnegative
constraints.description: Pattern usage counts must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: pattern_waste_nonnegative
constraints.description: Pattern waste area and total waste area must be nonnegative

constraints.name: single_stock_type_per_pattern
constraints.description: Each pattern must reference exactly one stock width type from the available stock types

constraints.name: full_order_satisfaction
constraints.description: Every order must be fully satisfied in both width and length
constraints.formula: \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} x_p a_{p i} q_{p i} = w_i,\qquad \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} x_p a_{p i} r_{p i} = \ell_i\quad \forall i \in \mathcal I

constraints.name: splicing_rule
constraints.description: If splicing is disabled, length pieces cannot be joined; if enabled, length may be fulfilled by multiple spliced pieces
constraints.formula: \sigma = 0 \Rightarrow \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} x_p a_{p i} \le 1\quad \forall i \in \mathcal I

constraints.name: pattern_waste_definition
constraints.description: Unused material area created by cutting a pattern contributes to that pattern's waste
constraints.formula: z_p = x_p \left(u_p \sum_{i \in \mathcal I} a_{p i} q_{p i} r_{p i} - \sum_{i \in \mathcal I} a_{p i} q_{p i} r_{p i}\right)\quad \forall p \in \mathcal P

constraints.name: aggregate_demand_coverage
constraints.description: Across all selected patterns and their usage counts, cumulative allocations must cover every order fully
constraints.formula: \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} x_p a_{p i} q_{p i} \ge w_i,\qquad \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} x_p a_{p i} r_{p i} \ge \ell_i\quad \forall i \in \mathcal I

objectives.name: total_waste_area_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total waste area across all used stock material

final_objective.description: Minimize the total waste area generated by all used stock material.
